description: This PHP file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee leave search results, including sorting and access controls.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee on-leave search results, extending FilterParams with specific properties like date and accessible employee numbers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with a default sort field 'employee.firstName'.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the DateTime object representing the filter date.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the DateTime object for the filter.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the array of accessible employee numbers.

methods.name: setAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the array of accessible employee numbers.
